review_a: >-
  The register here is internet-speak — "literally delusional," "chokehold
  energy," "plot twist nothing changed" — and I used it deliberately because I
  was trying to write about time perception the way people actually talk about
  time perception, not the way philosophers do. There's a kind of honesty in the
  meme format that formal language squanders. When someone says "happiness or I
